metrics.label: Change in annual-average HICP rate, 2024 to 2025

formula.name: difference_in_percentage_points
formula.expression: 2025 annual-average rate minus 2024 annual-average rate; this is a change in the rate, not a price-level change.

caveats: Values are annual-average HICP rates of change, not index levels, monthly rates, or the price change for an individual household.
The 2024-to-2025 result is a percentage-point change in the rate; the positive 2025 rate does not imply that prices fell.
This is the EU27_2020 aggregate and supports no country or euro-area comparison.
